one_liner: Amazon seller/vendor API for orders, listings, inventory and reports.
access_notes: Needs professional seller account and Amazon-reviewed developer profile; public apps use Appstore authorization via Login with Amazon.

blocker_note: Developer registration and role approval by Amazon; public multi-tenant apps need review/listing.
